articles.description: North America’s celestial highlights for the week ahead, which also apply to mid-northern latitudes in the northern hemisphere. This week sees a full Buck Moon rise.
articles.content: July closes with two of the celestial highlights of summer the rise of the full Buck Moon amid shooting stars from the Delta Aquariiid meteor shower. The latter peaks under less-than-ideal conditions… [+3713 chars]
